definitions.explanation: A method of random selection, typically used for deciding winners in competitions, allocating tickets, or distributing prizes.

examples.japanese: {抽選|ちゅうせん}で{当選者|とうせんしゃ}を{決|き}める。
examples.english: We'll decide the winner by lottery.

examples.japanese: コンサートのチケットは{抽選|ちゅうせん}で{販売|はんばい}される。
examples.english: Concert tickets will be sold through a lottery.

examples.japanese: {抽選|ちゅうせん}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだが、{外|はず}れた。
examples.english: I entered the lottery but didn't win.

notes:
FORMATION:
{抽|ちゅう} (draw/pull) + {選|せん} (select)

VERB FORM:
{抽選|ちゅうせん}する - to draw lots; to hold a lottery

COLLOCATIONS:
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}で{当|あ}たる - to win in a lottery
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}に{外|はず}れる - to lose in a lottery
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}む - to enter a lottery
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}{販売|はんばい} - lottery-based sales
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}{会|かい} - lottery drawing event
・{抽選|ちゅうせん}{結果|けっか} - lottery results

CONTRAST:
・{抽選|ちゅうせん} - lottery (random selection)
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} - first-come, first-served
・オークション - auction
